dia_forwork.title: Dia Browser | Work
dia_forwork.bodyText: What's New Apps Security Dia is built for work We’re getting Dia ready for companies of all sizes. What is Dia? Dia is a modern, AI-native browser that helps teams work faster, built with strong security controls and enterprise-grade management in mind. What makes Dia better than using my old browser with ChatGPT? Dia brings secure, native AI workflows into your browsing and apps, so you get productivity and compliance in one place. With Dia, there is no context switching, fewer copy-and-paste loops, and strong admin controls for data, access, and updates. Is Dia SOC 2 compliant? Yes. The Browser Company completed a SOC 2 Type II examination for Dia covering security, confidentiality, and privacy for calendar year 2025. The final report was issued in 2026. To learn more about our compliance program and to request a copy, visit trust.diabrowser.com. Does Dia or its AI systems train on corporate data? Dia has zero data retention (ZDR) agreements with all partners. Users can opt out from sharing content to improve Dia (see our Privacy page), and enterprises can disable content sharing org-wide. Does Dia offer AI security controls? Yes. Dia supports MDM controls that let you disable all AI-powered features on specific websites. How is my data kept private in Dia? Your data stays on your device and is stored encrypted. When you make an AI-powered request, we send only what’s needed to fulfill it (e.g., your prompt and relevant page context) through our servers to our AI partners. Does Dia support MDM controls? Yes. Dia supports standard Chromium enterprise policies, including Google Chrome Cloud Management, and also provides Dia-specific MDM policies such as AI controls and managed updates. Dia makes it easy for your IT team to be managed and deployed. Does Dia support Single Sign On (SSO)? Yes. Dia supports SAML-based SSO with most identity providers, including Google, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and more. You can also use Dia’s MDM policies to restrict sign-ins to approved email domains, ensuring only your employees can access Dia securely. Can I import my bookmarks, extensions, profiles, tabs, passwords, and history? Dia supports standard import flows from all major browsers. dia_changelog.title: Dia Browser | Product Updates
h2: Faster chat and more tab organization
dia_changelog.bodyText: What's New Apps Security Release Log Updated 4 days ago What’s new in Dia 2026 October September August July June May April March February January 2025 December November October September August All Mac Windows October 2026 October 8, 2026 Faster chat and more tab organization Mac v1.52.0 Dia 1.52.0 brings faster chat responses, more ways to organize your tabs, and smoother setup for connected tools. Arc-Style Pinned Tabs Pin tabs outside Favorites or Tab Groups for a familiar Arc-style layout, including when you import your setup from Arc. Shipped by Connor Active Tab Indicator When your active tab scrolls out of view, its favicon stays visible so you can keep your bearings. Shipped by Adam Faster Chat Responses Dia starts showing answer text and thinking sooner, so you spend less time waiting for a response to begin. Shipped by Rosey Simpler Atlassian Setup Signing in with your Atlassian account automatically connects Dia to Atlassian and streamlines setup across Atlassian sites. Shipped by Rishi Discover Connected Tools on the Page Sample queries and tool tours on sites with connected tools help you discover what Dia can do, right where you’re working. Shipped by Julia Clearer Chat Queue and Steering Controls “Send now” interrupts immediately, while clearer queue and stop controls make it easier to steer the conversation. Shipped by Rosey Close Tabs in One Click A new sidebar button lets you close unpinned tabs, with a “Close All Tabs” context-menu option for Tabs on Top. Shipped by Connor Extension Pinning Stays in Sync Unpinning an extension now carries across your synced devices, keeping your toolbar the way you left it. Shipped by Matthew October 8, 2026 Faster tabs, fewer hiccups Windows v1.1.0 Dia 1.1.0 for Windows brings faster tab performance, smoother profile switching, and better reliability across key integrations. Arc-Style Pinned Tabs Lets members pin tabs outside Favorites or groups, preserving familiar Arc organization and imports. Shipped by Connor Stream the First Chat Answer Block Immediately Streams the first answer text and thinking delta immediately so members see responses sooner. Shipped by Rosey Speed Up Tab Switching and Closing Makes tabs switch and close faster by avoiding unnecessary title-bar and relayout work. Shipped by Sébastien Improve Dialog Focus, Command Bar States, and Tab Alignment Dialogs focus fields automatically, command-bar selection is clearer, and tabs and sidebar controls align more consistently.
